constraint_source.reason_full_compatibility_open: the exact coupled radial operator and all adjoint kernels are not stored

dependencies.longitudinal: Codazzi plus the bulk momentum constraint equals the intrinsic Bianchi/stress-conservation identity
dependencies.temporal: the remaining scalar divergence is fixed by the bulk Hamiltonian/evolution identities and intrinsic conservation

symplectic_flux.matcher_term: zero after h=iota^*g and Lambda elimination
symplectic_flux.maximal_isotropic_conclusion: S_Sigma is a presymplectic null direction, so flux does not select a Lagrangian slope or a value on its one-dimensional trace line
symplectic_flux.metric_term: (1/2) integral_Sigma [delta1 J_mu_nu delta2 gamma^mu_nu-delta2 J_mu_nu delta1 gamma^mu_nu]
